messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync  We're running a small A/B price-sheet canary tomorrow 09:00 PT for early-beta + partners. Need clear grandfather rules and rollback steps.
Jordan Lee: Which accounts exactly? early-beta and partner cohorts only?
Maya Patel: Correct. Use filter: created_before=2023-11-01 AND promo=legacy_beta. Exclude account.meta.grandfather_exempt=true and any manual billing overrides.
Liam O'Connor: Vendor rates CSV uploaded: /sheets/vendor_rates_final.csv. I fixed a missing currency column.
Jordan Lee: @Liam please trigger billing-bot for preview regen.
Liam O'Connor: billing-bot: regen requested -> preview_id=prv_20240316_ab
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice preview ready: https://redwood.internal/preview/prv_20240316_ab
Maya Patel: Go checklist: 1) grandfather_flag=true for elig accounts, 2) no retro edits, 3) refund/escalation doc ready, 4) 25% holdback for 48h.
Ana Gomez: Finance needs a 4-line summary for leadership: risk, mitigations, approval id.
Jordan Lee: Draft: "A/B pricing canary for early-beta+partners. Risk: ~120 accounts may see changes. Mitigation: 25% holdback, monitoring, immediate rollback available. Refunds >$250 escalate to finance."
Ana Gomez: Fine. Add telemetry: avg invoice delta, pct impacted, top-10 accounts.
Liam O'Connor: Dashboard updated: /dashboards/pricing/ab_canary. Alerts set for avg_delta>50 or pct_impacted>3%.
Jordan Lee: Approvals: @Ana please sign off so SRE can schedule.
Ana Gomez: Approved. Finance approval ID FA-2024-0316. Proceed with canary and holdback.
Maya Patel: Ops: schedule at 09:00 PT, lock changes at 08:30 PT. If billing-bot reports missing schema or rows, abort and notify #finance immediately. :warning:
billing-bot: [automated] Job queued: job_id=job_2149999950 run_at=2024-03-16T16:00:00Z
Jordan Lee: Post-run: reconcile preview vs final invoices. I'll open ticket for any discrepancies >$250.
Maya Patel: CS message needed for customer-facing teams. Liam please draft and post to #customer-success.
Liam O'Connor: Will post draft in 10m.
Ana Gomez: Keep hourly updates in this thread for 2h post-deploy.
Jordan Lee: Will post first status at +1h.
Maya Patel: Final checks complete: vendor CSV , preview , finance approval FA-2024-0316 . Canary green to go.
